title: One Policy, Many Styles: Where to Aggregate Preferences for Steerable Humanoid Control?
abstract: arXiv:2610.28925v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Modern robotic agents are increasingly expected to support steerable control, where a single policy can adjust its behavioral style at runtime under changing user preferences. Preference-conditioned reinforcement learning provides this interface, but conditioning alone does not ensure that a requested behavior change is strong, does not leak into unrelated behaviors, and does not compromise task performance. Our evaluation combines Preference Reward Responsiveness (PRR) with coverage and utility metrics. We use these measures to compare reward-level, advantage-level, loss-level, and PCGrad-based aggregation across two humanoid-control frameworks. No aggregation level performs best across all environments and criteria. Experiments show that aggregating objectives early produces a wider range of behavioral responses but greater unintended changes in other objectives, while aggregating them later improves control precision at some cost to

translated_title: 一种策略，多种风格：在哪一层聚合偏好以实现可引导的人形机器人控制？
translated_abstract: 现代机器人智能体越来越被期望支持可引导控制，即单一策略能够在运行时根据不断变化的用户偏好调整其行为风格。偏好条件强化学习提供了这样的接口，但仅仅依靠条件化并不能保证所请求的行为改变足够强烈、不会泄露到无关行为中、也不会损害任务性能。我们的评估将偏好奖励响应性（PRR）与覆盖率和效用指标相结合，使用这些指标在两个人形机器人控制框架中比较了奖励层级、优势函数层级、损失层级以及基于PCGrad的聚合方式。结果显示，没有任何一个聚合层级能在所有环境和所有评估标准上都表现最佳。实验表明，较早聚合目标能产生更广泛的行为响应范围，但对其他目标会造成更大的非预期改变；而较晚聚合目标则能提高控制精度，但需要付出一定代价。
tldr: 该论文研究了偏好条件强化学习中偏好聚合层级（奖励、优势、损失、PCGrad）对人形机器人可引导控制的影响，发现没有单一聚合层级在所有环境下最优：早期聚合扩大行为响应范围但增加非预期改变，晚期聚合提升控制精度但有所取舍。
en_tdlr: This paper studies how preference aggregation levels (reward, advantage, loss, PCGrad) affect steerable humanoid control in preference-conditioned RL, finding that no single level dominates: early aggregation broadens behavioral responsiveness but increases unintended changes, while late aggregation improves control precision at some cost.
